title: Exam Preparation
src: Source: Lessons 1 to 9 (Lectures 01 to 08, Lab 01, Assignment 01). Final exam 02.11.2026, 2 hours, closed book.
lead: Final exam preparation: answer technique, definitions to memorise for every lesson, the most likely questions per lesson with the points a full answer needs, the comparison tables to be able to draw, and a 10-question mock paper with model answers plus a mixed mock MCQ test.
